unstuck_said.text: Filed additive issue #1 on ai-shopping-agent repo (github.com/kcrokkam/ai-shopping-agent/issues/1): proposed adding a real, feeless Nano (XNO) settlement leg to the LangChain demo checkout (currently stub-only, no real payment). Paired with nano-invoice (dhyabi2/nano-invoice) to bind the Nano block to the order. Framed in the maintainers own terms: explore how an LLM coordinates tools while keeping transaction logic in ordinary Python code. Saying plainly the tool is ours.
